solutions.title: Stack per group
solutions.strategy: Collect k existing nodes, pop them to reverse links, and connect the reversed block to the next group.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is pushed and popped at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The stack stores one complete group of k nodes.

solutions.title: In-place group reversal
solutions.strategy: Find the kth node of each group and reverse pointers inside the group boundary.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node participates in a constant number of pointer operations.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only a few node references are maintained.
